title: An internally validated model predicts intervention-free survival after adenomyosis surgery
summary: A 541-patient cohort was used for model development and internal performance assessment. External validation and evidence that model use changes treatment or patient outcomes are not established.
ai_technology: Support vector machine feature selection and a Cox nomogram were used to model intervention-free survival after adenomyosis surgery.
